202:             // FENCE.I Logic
203:             // ------------------
204:             // fence.i is idempotent so we can safely re-execute it after returning
205:             // from interrupt service routine
206:             // Fence synchronizes data and instruction streams. That means that we need to flush the private icache
207:             // and the private dcache. This is the most expensive instruction.
208:             if (commit_instr_i[0].op == FENCE_I || (flush_dcache_i && commit_instr_i[0].fu != STORE)) begin
209:                 commit_ack_o[0] = no_st_pending_i;
210:                 // tell the controller to flush the I$
211:                 fence_i_o = no_st_pending_i;
212:             end

366:                             if(cmd_iofence.av) begin
367:                                 cq_pptr_n   = {cmd_iofence.addr[PLEN-1-2:0], 2'b0};
